body.name: \(\mathcal D_k^\dagger\)
body.def: Order the \(2K\) annotation-rate coordinates as \((r_{01},r_{11},r_{02},r_{12},\ldots,r_{0K},r_{1K})\). Order child multi-indices \(b=(b_{01},b_{11},\ldots,b_{0K},b_{1K})\in\{0,1\}^{2K}\) lexicographically in that coordinate order, with \(0<1\). Set \(\mathcal D_0^\dagger=[\rho,1]^{2K}\). Given \(\mathcal D_k^\dagger\), index its \(2^{2K}\) closed dyadic child boxes by \(b\) and define \(\mathcal D_{k+1}^\dagger\) to be the lexicographically first child \(D_b\) satisfying \(\mathcal R_B\cap D_b\ne\varnothing\) and \(\min_{r\in\mathcal R_B\cap D_b}L(r)=V^*\). A point on a boundary shared by several closed children makes every child containing it separately eligible, and the same lexicographically first convention resolves that boundary tie. Only children of the already selected box \(\mathcal D_k^\dagger\) are eligible at depth \(k+1\).
